name: hcow-ledger
description: Public integrity anchor for HashCow game outcome records on BNB Chain

scripts.flatten: mkdir -p flat && hardhat flatten contracts/HCOWLedger.sol > flat/HCOWLedger.flat.sol && hardhat flatten contracts/HCOWProfitShare.sol > flat/HCOWProfitShare.flat.sol && hardhat flatten contracts/HCOWStaking.sol > flat/HCOWStaking.flat.sol && hardhat flatten contracts/HCOWFaucet.sol > flat/HCOWFaucet.flat.sol && hardhat flatten contracts/test/Mocks.sol > flat/TestTokens.flat.sol && node scripts/checkflat.cjs
scripts.test:all: hardhat compile && hardhat run test/ledger.test.cjs && hardhat run test/profitshare.test.cjs && hardhat run test/staking.test.cjs && hardhat run test/faucet.test.cjs && node test/keccak.check.cjs && node test/web.check.cjs && hardhat run test/anchor.check.cjs
